name: optiq-loop
description: Applies source changes ROCm Optiq proposed and you approved, then rebuilds - the editor half of the profile, edit, profile again loop.

optiq.buildCommand.markdownDescription: Shell command that rebuilds this workspace, run from the first workspace folder. Optiq runs it after a change you approved and reads the output back, so a compile error becomes the assistant's next fix. Example: `cmake --build build`.
